description: This PHP class, FraudDetectorClient, extends AwsClient and provides an interface to AWS's Amazon Fraud Detector service, including method documentation for available service operations and Async variants.

classes.name: FraudDetectorClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with Amazon Fraud Detector service, providing methods for managing detectors, variables, models, and predictions.

methods.name: batchCreateVariable
methods.description: Creates multiple variables for fraud detection.

methods.name: batchCreateVariableAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates multiple variables for fraud detection.

methods.name: createDetectorVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of a fraud detector.

methods.name: createDetectorVersionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new version of a fraud detector.
